description: American Dental Association member dentists near a US ZIP code, from ADA Find-a-Dentist: dentist name, specialties (general practice, orthodontics, endodontics…), practice name, practice address and the ADA profile link, closest first (up to 100 per search). ADA members only; not every licensed dentist is listed. Price: $0.01 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

address.description: US ZIP code (most reliable) or a street address with ZIP; a bare city name returns no cards

specialty.description: Optional filter on the specialty text, e.g. orthodontics, pediatric
